title: bias_core schematic-entry smoke check: untrimmed nominal operating point
claim: Harness bring-up for issue #17 -- NOT a spec claim (spec/target-spec.md does not exist yet, spec/porting-plan.md Sec4 item 4). Substantiates that sim/bin/corner-run.py, ported from sky130-bandgap, actually drives THIS repo's own design/bias_core.sch through xschem/ngspice across the full 45-point PVT matrix, and that the process/voltage/temperature knobs measurably change the result. design/bias_core.md already documents an informal, uncommitted spot check at tt/ff/ss x -40/27/125 degC; this record is the harness's own first COMMITTED sim/ evidence, across the full 5-corner x 3-temp x 3-supply grid, not a spot check.
statistical_convention: N/A (corner-matrix check, not a distribution claim)

measurements.name: vref
measurements.note: Untrimmed reference output, open circuit. design/bias_core.md's own spot check found 1.2477-1.2574 V across tt/ff/ss x -40/27/125 degC; this window is deliberately a few-hundred-mV harness liveness bound around that, NOT a spec claim -- no spec/target-spec.md exists yet (spec/porting-plan.md Sec4 item 4).

measurements.name: ibias
measurements.note: IBIAS is open-circuit (no load in this testbench), so per design/bias_core.md's own compliance note (V(IBIAS) <= VDD - 0.2V, but open-circuit it rails toward VDD) this should read close to the corner's own vsup. Window covers the full 2.97-3.63 V supply range with margin.

measurements.name: bias_ok
measurements.note: BIAS_OK active-high settle flag; should read rail-high (near vsup) once the core is up. Failing this across the matrix would mean the startup kick is not reliably clearing the degenerate zero-current state at some corner.

measurements.name: isup
measurements.note: Total quiescent supply current. design/bias_core.md's own spot check found ~0.94 uA at tt/27C/3.3V; window is a generous harness liveness bound, not the (not-yet-ratified) Iq spec line.

spread_checks.note: Guards against a silently corner-blind harness: if every corner returns the same vref, the .lib/.temp injection is not taking effect. design/bias_core.md's own spot check already found a ~9.7 mV vref spread across process x temperature alone (1.2477-1.2574 V), so this bound is well inside what a working harness should observe.

notes: The full 45-point matrix's committed record (sim/bias-core-smoke/records/) shows overall FAIL: 43/45 corners PASS in the documented VREF band, but tt_27c_2.97v and tt_27c_3.63v both land on a different, spurious DC solution (VREF railed near VDD, milliamp-scale static current) -- present at exactly one process/temperature point, at both supply extremes but not the center supply. This is real evidence a working full-PVT-grid harness surfaced (design/bias_core.md's own prior spot check never varied supply, so it could not have found this) -- NOT a harness defect, and left as a genuine committed FAIL record per sim/'s append-only convention rather than edited/loosened to force a PASS. Filed as a follow-up circuit-behavior investigation, out of scope for issue #17 (harness port) per that issue's own 'Explicitly out of scope' section: https://github.com/2AMLogic/sky130-temp-por/issues/19
